as_told.title: SAR scan of the Great Pyramid showing the Grand Gallery and the big void

plain: A researcher named Filippo Biondi says his team, using synthetic aperture radar (a way of building images from radar signals, usually taken from satellites), detected the Big Void inside Egypt's Great Pyramid, a large hidden empty space, and placed it lying crosswise, east to west. Biondi tells Michels he worked on this himself, with a colleague he names as Corrado, and dates the work to 2018 to 2020. He stresses that 'these are not simulated data. Are real data,' and says the scans also pick up the Grand Gallery, a long sloping passage inside the pyramid, which would suggest the method can see real structure through stone.
